newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent market open, fuel oil closed Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent market open, fuel oil closed Wednesday.

text.p: The Brent crude oil futures market on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) is open on Wednesday, although most Singapore financial markets are closed to mark a national holiday.
The SIMEX Brent market follows the U.K. trading calendar because positions in Singapore can be mutually offset against positions on the larger International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) in London.
However, the SIMEX fuel oil futures market is closed to mark the Buddhist Vesak Day. It resumes normal trading on Thursday.
